title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before placing tables, chairs or other furniture on a footpath, road or other public land for outdoor dining.

sources.title: City of Perth Outdoor Dining Local Law 2019
sources.locator: cl 2.1, as made, Gazette No. 71, 27 May 2019
sources.quote: Unless exempt under clause 2.2, a person must not set up or conduct an outdoor dining area in a public place—

sources.title: City of Perth Outdoor Dining Local Law 2019
sources.locator: cl 2.1(c), as made, Gazette No. 71, 27 May 2019
sources.quote: (c) unless the person is a permit holder; and

sources.title: Outdoor dining permit city of perth
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit if you intend to provide an alfresco dining area on a footpath or in a public area.
